name: React Application for Complex Data Management and Visualization
description: This product aims to develop a highly intuitive and scalable React application that enables users to efficiently manage and interact with complex data structures through a seamless and visually appealing interface. The application will cater to developers, data analysts, and project managers by providing robust tools for data visualization and management.

enhancedPrompt.productVision: To create a highly intuitive and scalable React application that empowers users to efficiently manage and interact with complex data structures through a seamless and visually appealing interface.
enhancedPrompt.targetUsers: Developers, data analysts, and project managers who require a robust tool for data visualization and management.
personas: John, a senior developer who needs a customizable dashboard for monitoring application performance.
Sarah, a data analyst who requires detailed data visualization tools to interpret large datasets.
Mike, a project manager who needs a user-friendly interface to track project progress and team performance.
userStories: As a developer, I want to customize my dashboard so that I can monitor specific metrics relevant to my tasks.
As a data analyst, I need to visualize large datasets in various chart formats to better understand trends and patterns.
As a project manager, I want to track team performance in real-time to ensure project milestones are met.
As a user, I want to export reports in PDF and Excel formats for sharing with stakeholders.
As an admin, I need to manage user roles and permissions to ensure data security.
userFlows: User logs in, views the dashboard, and customizes widgets.
User navigates to the data visualization page, selects a dataset, and chooses a chart type.
Admin accesses the user management page, updates roles, and saves changes.
enhancedPrompt.architecture: The application will follow a modular architecture with React components, Redux for state management, and Axios for API interactions. The backend will be built using Node.js with Express, and data will be served via RESTful APIs.
enhancedPrompt.database: MongoDB will be used for its flexibility with JSON-like documents, allowing for easy storage and retrieval of complex data structures.
uxRequirements: Responsive design for various screen sizes
Accessible interface compliant with WCAG standards
technicalRequirements: Support for modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Integration with third-party APIs for data fetching
edgeCases: User attempts to access unauthorized pages
acceptanceCriteria: All core features are implemented and functional
Application passes all unit and integration tests
User interface meets all UX requirements
successMetrics: Average page load time under 2 seconds
risks: Potential security vulnerabilities in API endpoints
Scalability issues with increasing user base

prd.title: React Application for Complex Data Management and Visualization
prd.overview: This product aims to develop a highly intuitive and scalable React application that enables users to efficiently manage and interact with complex data structures through a seamless and visually appealing interface. The application will cater to developers, data analysts, and project managers by providing robust tools for data visualization and management.
goals: Provide an intuitive user interface for managing complex data structures.
Enable customizable data visualization to cater to diverse user needs.
Ensure real-time data updates for timely decision-making.
Implement role-based access control to maintain data security.
Facilitate easy export of reports in multiple formats for sharing with stakeholders.
prd.targetAudience: Developers, data analysts, and project managers requiring robust data visualization and management tools.

userPersonas.name: John
goals: Monitor specific metrics relevant to tasks.
Customize dashboard for efficient performance tracking.

userPersonas.name: Sarah
goals: Visualize large datasets in various chart formats.
Understand trends and patterns in data.
behaviors: Uses multiple chart formats for data interpretation.

userPersonas.name: Mike
goals: Track team performance in real-time.
Ensure project milestones are met.
painPoints: Difficulty in real-time team performance tracking.
Lack of user-friendly interfaces for project management.
behaviors: Prefers intuitive interfaces for project tracking.

features.name: Interactive Data Visualization Charts
features.description: Provides various chart formats for visualizing large datasets.

features.name: Customizable Dashboard Widgets
features.description: Allows users to customize dashboard widgets to monitor specific metrics.

features.name: Real-Time Data Updates
features.description: Ensures data is updated in real-time for timely decision-making.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Manages user roles and permissions to ensure data security.

features.name: Exportable Reports
features.description: Allows users to export reports in PDF and Excel formats.

userStories.title: Customizable Dashboard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to customize my dashboard so that I can monitor specific metrics relevant to my tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: User can add/remove widgets from the dashboard.
Widgets display relevant metrics accurately.

userStories.title: Data Visualization
userStories.description: As a data analyst, I need to visualize large datasets in various chart formats to better understand trends and patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select different chart types.
Charts accurately represent the selected dataset.

userStories.title: Real-Time Team Performance Tracking
userStories.description: As a project manager, I want to track team performance in real-time to ensure project milestones are met.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard updates team performance metrics in real-time.
Metrics are displayed accurately and timely.

userStories.title: Export Reports
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export reports in PDF and Excel formats for sharing with stakeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: User can export reports in PDF and Excel formats.
Exported reports retain all data and formatting.

userStories.title: Manage User Roles
userStories.description: As an admin, I need to manage user roles and permissions to ensure data security.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add/update user roles.
Permissions are enforced correctly based on roles.

prd.technicalStack: React, Redux, WebSocket, Charting Libraries, Authentication Service, Report Generation Libraries
constraints: Ensure high performance with real-time updates.
Maintain data security with role-based access control.
successMetrics: User satisfaction score of at least 4.5/5.
Average dashboard load time under 2 seconds.
Report export functionality used by 80% of users.
Real-time data updates with less than 1-second latency.
prd.timeline: Q1: Requirements Gathering and Design, Q2: Development of Core Features, Q3: Testing and Bug Fixes, Q4: Deployment and User Training
